• ACMESOLAR (New Projects): ## Executive Summary: ACME Solar Holdings Limited has announced the commissioning of an additional 88.02 MW / 366.969 MWh Battery Energy Storage System (BESS) component in Rajasthan, with commercial operations set to begin on November 1, 2026. This expands their subsidiary's cumulative commissioned BESS capacity to 159.660 MW / 664.261 MWh, marking significant progress on the FDRE Project and enhancing future revenue potential. The update reflects positive project execution without any apparent material negative impacts or red flags. └ 📄 Source

• ADFFOODS (Results): ADF Foods Limited announced a Board Meeting on November 5, 2026, to approve its unaudited standalone and consolidated financial results for the quarter and half-year ended September 30, 2026, and to consider declaring an interim dividend for FY 2026-27. This is a material event for investors, as the impending financial disclosure will provide crucial insights into the company's recent performance, and a dividend declaration could signal management confidence and directly impact shareholder returns. No significant red flags are apparent, with the trading window closure until November 7, 2026, being a standard regulatory compliance measure around such announcements. └ 📄 Source

• ADANIPOWER (Concalls): Executive Summary: Adani Power Q2 FY27 Earnings Adani Power delivered a "blockbuster" Q2 FY27, reporting a 142% surge in Profit After Tax to over INR7,000 crores, primarily driven by strong power demand, improved plant load factors, and a material one-time prior period revenue adjustment of INR2,422 crores. The company's operational strength is underscored by a credit rating upgrade to AA+ and significant progress on its 24 GW thermal and new hydro capacity expansions, despite a 41.8% increase in fuel costs largely managed by pass-through mechanisms. While the substantial one-time revenue inflated reported PAT, the underlying operational and strategic growth remains strong. └ 📄 Source

• ADROITIND (Results): Adroit Industries reported robust Q2 FY27 results, with H1 revenue increasing 11% and EBITDA soaring 48% year-over-year, significantly expanding margins to 29.3%. The company is leveraging IPO funds for a substantial capacity expansion, aiming to double machining and assembly capacity by Q4 FY27 and increase forging capacity by Q1 FY28, which is projected to support annual revenue potential of Rs. 2,500 million. Strategic initiatives include diversifying into industrial and defense segments, expanding international presence, and improving margins through in-house manufacturing, while addressing a high working capital cycle that management expects to optimize without further fundraising. └ 📄 Source

This strategic move aims to diversify product offerings and strengthen its position within the AI Infra and Data Centre sector, with future tranches of acquisition also planned. However, the announcement lacks crucial financial details regarding Aerolex Cables, making it difficult to fully assess the acquisition's valuation and potential financial impact. └ 📄 Source
